concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-verification-requirements-onboarding-guidelines]] — 2026-09-15 in-development Platforms onboarding guide for general KYC and selected country/entity-specific ID, organization and bank-document conditions; dated guidance does not prove current eligibility or granted capabilities.
warnings: The page explicitly covers selected countries/regions and is still in development; its trust support and local document statements are snapshot-bound, not current universal availability or legal advice.

Keep individual, organization, sole-proprietorship and trust conditions and countries separate; creating or submitting documents is not completed verification or permission to process, offer financial products or pay out.
Bank-detail verification and payout-bank documents are not payout execution or bank-receipt proof.
